ValidationRule.description: Closeout_Quantities_Confirmed__c must be true before status can change to Pending Closeout Approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Pending Closeout Approval"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Pending Closeout Approval")), NOT(Closeout_Quantities_Confirmed__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Installed quantities must be confirmed before closeout approval. Review each WO Line Item, enter actual quantities, check Closeout Quantities Confirmed. Note any outside-PO scope in Outside PO Notes.
